title: Dow Dives Into Correction As Chance Of Rate Hike Spikes: What Do Prediction Markets Think? - Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT)
summary: Futures traders increased the probability of a Fed rate hike by year-end to 52%, with significant impact on the bond and stock markets, including a peak in the 10-year yield and decline in Microsoft stock. The OECD raised its U.S. inflation forecast, and various financial institutions are adjusting their recession probabilities in response to the changing economic landscape.
sentiment_reason: The focus on the potential Fed rate hike and the resulting volatility in the bond and stock markets, along with increased inflation forecasts, contribute to a negative sentiment due to the fear of a possible recession and the impact on investments.
